唤醒

平台对所有任务生效的规则。每个任务可以在自己的「唤醒」区域单独修改。

子任务结束时

某个阶段的子任务全部结束、且后面还有阶段在等待时，唤醒父任务的负责人；全部子任务结束时再唤醒一次。负责人是成员时，改为发送收件箱通知。

默认开启
默认指令

发给被唤醒的智能体。留空则使用下方的内置指令。

内置指令

Sub-issues of this issue have closed; the trigger facts list each stage and which one is next. If a later stage is waiting, check that its dependencies are met, then move its sub-issues out of backlog so they start. If a sub-issue in the closed stages was cancelled rather than finished, decide whether its work is still needed before advancing. When every sub-issue is closed, bring their results together on this issue and move it forward, or mark it ready for review when nothing remains.

保存
